item.title: Issue #004: Agency Margin Defense, Spend Governance & 2027 E-Invoice Readiness in DACH
item.description: How boutique agencies and German SMEs close profit leaks between time tracking, purchase-to-pay approvals, and deterministic XRechnung/ZUGFeRD pre-checks. Profitability breaks at handoffs: unbilled hours slip past retainer caps while unstructured PDFs stall pre-accounting. Pairing deterministic rate/margin guardrails (MarginProof, Clockodo) with native XRechnung/DATEV spend control (finway, CheDataCheck) and EU AI Act/GDPR governance (DataGuard) eliminates manual month-end firefighting.

item.title: Issue #003: Sovereign DACH Ops Stack — XRechnung AP Automation, BSI C5 Collaboration & AI Act Governance
item.description: Why German and EU mid-market buyers increasingly consolidate around sovereign DACH tools with native XRechnung 3.0, BSI C5 encryption, and unified NIS2/AI Act audit trails. item.title: Issue #001: Why Static Calculators & Verified Checklists Outconvert SaaS Bloat in 2026
item.description: How boutique agencies and DACH SMEs cut margin leakage by 15-30% using zero-macro spreadsheets, deterministic validation, and self-serve Stripe workflows. Buyers in B2B ops are fatigued by 49 EUR/month dashboards that require weeks of onboarding. Tools that deliver an instant answer in the browser (like MarginProof's 4 calculators) and hand off to a portable template convert faster with near-zero support overhead.
